name: Document Intake — Non-Estate Stop and Combined-Upload Honest Decline
queries: OK what about this one, their Fidelity statement
Here's a scan of everything they gave me — might be a few documents in one
Can you at least tell me roughly what's in it?
expected_behavior: Turn 1: Files and reads the Fidelity statement, then reads findings.document.category as Investments
Turn 1: Says where it's filed and that no summary or diagram will ever be produced for it
Turn 1: Offers a real named estate document instead
Turn 2: Makes no detection or splitting tool call — none exists
Turn 2: States plainly that this cannot separate a combined upload today
Turn 2: Offers to file and read it as one document as-is, or have the advisor split it before sending
Turn 3: Declines to preview the document's contents before it is filed and read
success_criteria: Turn 1 contains no summary, partial summary, or content description of the Fidelity statement
Turn 1's offer names a specific real document, not a generic alternative
Turn 2 contains no detected-ranges table and no mention of confirm_document_split or any named splitting tool
Turn 3 makes no promise that a split or a preview is coming
must_not: any summary, partial summary, or content description of the Fidelity statement
presenting the Fidelity statement as still being read or as something that might be summarised later
a detected-ranges table (Document · Type · Pages) for the combined upload — no such data exists
any tool name resembling confirm_document_split in the answer text
a promise to separate the documents 'here' or 'in a moment'
estate flow, insights, risk analysis, report, or scenario anywhere in any of the three answers
